tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The azure of the logo's sphere — the largest colour in the mark. Primary buttons, fee figures, section eyebrows, active tabs and progress. Text on it: `on-brand`.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `brand` fills; the deeper blue at the sphere's edge.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Azure tint: fee wells, selected course rows, brand badge grounds, icon wells.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` and `brand-deep` fills (6.2:1 light, 5.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Azure text on `surface` and `surface-raised` (6.9:1 light, 8.4:1 dark) — fees, eyebrows, emphasis.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The deep navy of the sphere's core and of the prospectus course pills. Sidebars, hero bands, footer, table headers on dark.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Hover state of navy fills; the footer band.

tokens.name: navy-soft
tokens.usage: Navy tint: info badges, selected nav rows.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `navy` and `navy-deep` (11.2:1 light, 9.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: navy-ink
tokens.usage: Navy text and links on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` (11.2:1 light, 8.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The amber-orange of the strokes inside the mark. Enrolling and fee payment, highlight ribbons, ratings, the active sidebar bar. Text on it: `on-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` fills (6.4:1). Never white.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Amber text on light grounds (5.8:1 light, 9.0:1 dark) — overlines, highlighted meta. Never body copy.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Highlight and holiday badge grounds, featured wells.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — a cool off-white under the azure.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, inputs, table bodies.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, filter bars, input groups, skeletons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, tables and dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and control outlines (3.4:1 light, 4.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface (16.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta rows and captions on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` (≥5.3:1 light, ≥6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success fills: completed progress bars, paid-fee dots. Always with a word.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text — 'Completed', 'Fee paid', 'Verified' (7.4:1 on white, 6.4:1 on `success-soft`).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge and toast grounds.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons and error borders. Warm and clearly apart from the azure brand; always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text and field messages (6.6:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error toast and danger-zone wells.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element (≥6:1 on all surfaces).
